02
Tutto.Lesson 2 · Foundation
Lesson 2 — what "in action" means

Not autocomplete. A teammate that acts.

An agent doesn't just talk about your code — it works inside your terminal and your repo.

  • Reads the files that matter, on its own.
  • Edits across many of them in one go.
  • Runs commands to check its own work.

The course demos this on a small UI-generation app — but nothing's special about it. You can follow along on a codebase of your own.

03
Tutto.Lesson 2 · The loop
The session is a loop

You stay in command.

It does the busy work; you set the heading and keep the wheel.

  • You ask — in plain English.
  • It works — reads, edits, runs to check.
  • You review the diff, then go round again.

Every change comes back as a diff you approve. The agent is fast and tireless; the judgement stays yours.
